gen-gf-barriecito-gf-epunda-slab: Loud, bouncy, unmistakably playful up top. Epunda Slab holds the lower half with a text serif's dignity, its tall rounded lowercase letting Barriecito do the showing off.
gen-gf-barriecito-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads like a quiet literary voice, with a tall middle band and a generous opening into each e. Over a long passage it stays gentle, with Barriecito's ladle-shaped bowls above.
gen-gf-barriecito-gf-glegoo: Barriecito's open bowls tip forward like ladles, a big-bodied lowercase beside compact capitals. Glegoo follows in a text serif with big counters, and curves that leave their mouths wide unclosed.
gen-gf-barriecito-gf-graduate: Barriecito brings its ladle-like bowls and compact capitals to the heading, loose and full of character. And Graduate answers with a serif drawn at a single constant line width, spaced generously, so capitals and lowercase barely differ in height.
gen-gf-barriecito-gf-hanuman: Playful on top, traditional below. Hanuman, a text serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s, is the one to size up a notch if the page feels small.
gen-gf-barriecito-gf-noticia-text: Barriecito's open bowls curve like a tipped ladle, over a big-bodied lowercase and compact capitals. Noticia Text, a serif with big entrances, reads smoothly down the page.
gen-gf-barriecito-gf-piazzolla: Open bowls like tipped ladles and a big-bodied lowercase give Barriecito its swagger, with compact capitals beside it. Piazzolla's text serif lowercase nearly matches its capitals, and that makes the pair feel so confident.
gen-gf-barriecito-gf-pridi: Expressive from the first glance, Barriecito spills its ladle-shaped bowls across the heading. But Pridi, a classic serif with small letters standing almost capital-sized, gives the pair its strongest quality: a steady, grown-up footing.
gen-gf-barriecito-gf-scope-one: Scope One reads with counters that spill into the space around them, and stubby ascenders next to a big x-height. Barriecito's loose, ladle-like bowls up top make a longer passage feel unhurried.
gen-gf-barriecito-gf-slabo-13px: Barriecito leads with ladle-like open bowls and compact capitals. Slabo 13px follows as a serif whose tall a, e and s have large open counters, so the heading's flair gives way to a body that stays easy to take in.
